item.title: Industrial Lifting Solutions with Pneumatic Chain Hoists
item.description:
Advancing Material Handling with Pneumatic Chain Hoists
#

In industrial environments where reliability, safety, and precision are essential, pneumatic (air) chain hoists provide a robust solution for lifting and material handling. Cheng Day delivers air hoists engineered for a wide range of applications, including food-grade settings, mines, shipyards, power plants, cement facilities, onshore and offshore drilling, and oil and gas production platforms.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Heavy Lifting and Material Handling
item.description:
Comprehensive Solutions for Heavy Lifting and Material Handling
#

Cheng Day (Black Bear / U-Mega) stands as an internationally certified supplier and manufacturer of heavy lifting equipment, material handling systems, elevator, and parking solutions. With a strong foundation in research and development at our Taiwan headquarters, we design and produce a full spectrum of lifting equipment and related components, adhering to national and international standards such as CMAA, HMI, JIS, and FEM.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Manual and Electric Trolleys
item.description:
Versatile Trolley Systems for Industrial Applications
#

Cheng Day offers a comprehensive selection of trolley systems, including manual trolleys, electric trolleys, and chain hoist trolleys, with capacities ranging from 0.5 ton to 20 ton. These trolleys are engineered to accommodate different beam sizes, ensuring adaptability for diverse operational requirements. Adjustments can be made easily by relocating the spacing washers either inside or outside the frame, allowing for a precise fit to the specified beam dimensions.
